organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Workspace name, timezone and default currency. The currency is only the display default — each amount is stored in its own currency with its USD value at the event date.
organization.name: Organization name

errors.name: Name must be at least 2 characters

security.title: Security
security.description: Session timeout, IP allowlist and your organization's 2FA policy.
security.require2faHint: Every member must set up 2FA on their next sign-in — set up your own under "Your two-factor authentication" below.
security.allowlistPlaceholder:
One IP or CIDR per line, e.g.
203.0.113.4
198.51.100.0/24
security.allowlistHint: An empty list means no restriction. Applies to sign-in only — an existing session stays valid from any IP.

totp.title: Your two-factor authentication
totp.description: A code from an authenticator app, asked at sign-in in addition to your password.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
totp.backupHint: Each code works once. They won't be shown again.
totp.disableDescription: Confirm your password to turn off 2FA for your account.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For programmatic access. The full key is shown once, when it is created.
apiKeys.scopeHint: The scope decides what the key can read or change. Read: everything a member can see. Write: read, plus creating, editing and deleting campaigns, offers, content and more — team and security settings excluded. Admin: everything, team and security included.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time it is shown in full. If you lose it, revoke the key and create a new one.
apiKeys.usageAfter: on any API request — it signs in the same way your session does, within the key's scope.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working immediately.
